input: How long do I have to request a refund?

expected.gold_answer: Nimbus has a 30-day money-back guarantee; you can request a full refund within 30 days of payment.
Support is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM US Eastern Time, closed on weekends and US public holidays.

input: Which identity providers does your SSO support?

expected.gold_answer: SSO uses SAML 2.0 (on the Enterprise plan) and supports Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace.

input: What does the Starter plan cost and what's included?

expected.gold_answer: Starter is $12 per user per month and includes up to 5 projects and 10 GB of storage.
